candidates.name: bigram_confusion_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Replacing the ASCII-only tokenizer with Chinese character bigrams will make similarity retrieval actually semantic, causing the confusion-matrix disambiguation phase to operate on meaningful signal rather than random noise, improving score above 27/100.

candidates.name: contrastive_correction_memory
candidates.hypothesis: Injecting a 'Mistakes to avoid' block of similar wrong→right correction pairs before the examples will steer the model away from fine-grained label boundary errors (e.g. 诈骗→合同诈骗, 行贿→单位行贿), improving score above 27/100 independently of confusion-matrix accumulation.
